description: Search for tokens by symbol or name across all monitored exchanges. Each item has `rating` {grade, grade_detail} (the 7-day liquidity grade, same as get_token_intel `rating`); the top-level `grade` is the last single scan's grade, with `grade_last_as_of` and `grade_last_stale` saying how old that scan is. Requires: query.

exchange.description: Filter by exchange id or two-letter venue code (optional)
